base: Edit this children's black-and-white coloring worksheet for a spot-the-difference game. Preserve original canvas aspect ratio, camera, all positions, sizes, line weight, pure white background and every unmentioned detail EXACTLY. Make ONLY the ten requested local semantic changes. No added stars, hearts, circles, spots, numbers, labels or decorative symbols.
